summary: With thousands of signatures and a protest planned, a developer withdrew a data center plan hours before the planning board was to hear it.
realLife: In Nottingham, New Hampshire, in May 2026, over 25,000 people signed a petition and the developer's lawyer withdrew the plan around 1:30 p.m. the day of the meeting, citing more research.
sources: New Hampshire Public Radio, Nottingham data center proposal withdrawn after backlash: https://www.nhpr.org/nh-news/2026-05-27/nottingham-data-center-proposal-withdrawn-after-backlash
inGame: a cause shared by a neighbor, a protest formed by the public-action engine, a posted meeting; the item leaves the agenda.

turns.summary: The plan stays and residents speak against it.
The developer says the plan may come back with more information.
turns.writesBack: cause stays alive; neighbor ties watchful

turns.summary: With the plan gone the crowd disperses.
